ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. The course is delivered entirely on-line, using a password-protected course management site (Illinois Compass) which allows class participants to post information on an electronic bulletin board, submit homework, quizzes and exams electronically, and participate in weekly two-hour chat sessions (scheduled at a time convenient for all participants). As Illinois Compass uses the latest web technologies, to participate in the course, students will likely need to update their browers before logging on for the first time.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $497.00 per Bill Hour, and Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Fees $36.00 per Bill Hour.
